query:
Compensation of competence refers to the mutual substitution and compensation of different competences of the same individual or among members of the organization, so as to maintain or maintain the normal progress of activities. Among them, radiation compensation refers to the phenomenon that the superior ability effectively strengthens the mutual connection between various abilities or drives the improvement of other abilities at the same time. Amplified compensation refers to the high development of superior capabilities, which effectively compensates for some weak capabilities.

Radiation compensation is applied to the No. 7 player of Country A football team.

repl_history.response:
The GLOBAL CONTEXT PREVIEW is sufficient for determining this simple statement.

I find that "Amplified compensation" is defined as developing superior capabilities to make up for weak ones, which isn't even in this context so it doesn't fit with being related to the No. 7 player.


However, reading further into it we do notice:  
"...radiation compensation refers to the phenomenon that the superior ability effectively strengthens the mutual connection between various abilities or drives the improvement of other abilities at the same time."



Since "radiation compensation" is now in sight and the given context involves that No. 7 player we can easily say that...

 FINAL ANSWER: Radiation
